description: A picture of the coin's chart with Asrai's own indicators drawn on it (ASR trend lines, TD9 / SuperTD9 marks, ALSAT marks, Bollinger bands, RSI divergence). Returns a public image URL — to show the picture, put the returned `markdown` (![…](image_url)) in your answer exactly as given; never link the chart page as an image. inline:true also returns the PNG itself for agents that can look at images (large).

inline.description: Also return the PNG as image content (default false)

name: chart_snapshot
